name: The Settler's Almanac
landing_text: Village civilization once reached every valley. It built past its walls and dug below the old marks, and the world answered with sickness and monsters. The towns emptied. You are a settler in Year One after that, in the one old town still standing. This almanac is what the survivors remembered.$(br2)Open a chapter on the left; new settlers start with $(l:patchouli:start/first_hour)Your First Hour$(). Blue text is a link. Lost it? A book and wheat seeds make another.
